title: Throw
subtitle: 「扔／拋／投／猛力甩出」，究竟是哪一種 throw？
description: 「扔／拋／投／猛力甩出」，究竟是哪一種 throw？

words.note: 常表示較隨意、較輕地把某物拋出去，通常距離不遠；比一般 throw 更輕鬆、口語。
words.example: She tossed the keys onto the table.
words.exampleZh: 她把鎖匙隨手拋到桌上。

exercises.original: She threw the keys onto the sofa without looking.
exercises.zh: 她沒有看就隨手把鎖匙拋到梳化上。

options.explanation: hurled = 對 keys 來說力度太強，也會改變語氣。
heaved = 通常用於沉重物件。
toss = without looking + keys/sofa 呈現隨手輕拋，因此 tossed 最自然。
pitched = 不合日常把鎖匙扔到梳化。
launched = 語氣過強、太戲劇化。
dropped = 會變成向下掉落，不一定到 sofa 上。

exercises.original: He threw the towel to his teammate after practice.
exercises.zh: 練習後，他把毛巾拋給隊友。

options.explanation: cast = 太正式，也不自然配 towel。
toss = 柔軟、輕的 towel 短距離交給隊友，tossed 很自然。

exercises.original: She threw the coin into the fountain.
exercises.zh: 她把硬幣拋進噴泉。

options.explanation: toss = 硬幣通常是輕輕拋出，tossed 比 general throw 更貼切。

words.note: 較正式或文學性，也常見於固定搭配，例如 cast a net、cast a line、cast a vote；在某些物理投擲語境可替代 throw。
words.example: The fisherman cast the net into the water.

exercises.original: The fisherman threw the net into the river.
exercises.zh: 漁夫把網撒進河裡。

options.explanation: tossed = 過於隨意，不如 cast net 是固定搭配。
heaved = 可有力量感，但缺少漁業固定用法。
cast = cast a net 是標準固定搭配。
dropped = 只是放下，不是撒網。

exercises.original: She threw her fishing line into the lake.
exercises.zh: 她把釣魚線拋進湖裡。

options.explanation: tossed = 可理解但不如 fishing 固定用法自然。
cast = 釣魚時 cast a line 是最標準的表達。

exercises.original: The actor threw a long shadow across the stage under the spotlight.
exercises.zh: 演員在聚光燈下把長長的影子投在舞台上。

options.explanation: tossed = shadow 不能被物理拋擲。
cast = cast a shadow 是固定搭配，這裡不是實際投擲，但仍是 throw 的語義延伸。

words.note: 表示用很大力氣把某物扔出去，常帶憤怒、速度或危險感；比一般 throw 強烈很多。
words.example: He hurled the stone across the field.
words.exampleZh: 他把石頭猛力扔過田野。

exercises.original: He threw the brick through the broken window in anger.
exercises.zh: 他憤怒地把磚塊猛力扔過破窗。

options.explanation: tossed = 力度太輕，和 in anger 不符。
lobbed = 高弧線、較柔和，不合。
cast = 太正式且不合 anger。
hurl = brick + in anger 明確需要強烈的 hurled。
dropped = 方向和力量都不符。

exercises.original: The protester threw a bottle toward the barrier.
exercises.zh: 示威者把瓶子猛力扔向圍欄。

options.explanation: hurl = 帶衝突和力量感的投擲，用 hurl 很自然。

exercises.original: He threw the stone as hard as he could.
exercises.zh: 他盡全力把石頭扔出去。

options.explanation: hurl = as hard as he could 直接支持 hurled。
tossed = 與 as hard as he could 矛盾。

words.note: 表示快速、突然地把某物扔開或甩出去，常帶情緒或不經意的力量；比 toss 更猛烈。
words.example: She flung her bag onto the chair.
words.exampleZh: 她把手袋猛地甩到椅子上。

exercises.original: She threw her coat onto the bed and rushed out.
exercises.zh: 她把外套猛地甩到床上，然後衝了出去。

options.explanation: tossed = 可用但會弱化急促和情緒。
placed = 和 rushed out 的急促感不符。
dropped = 不是有方向地甩到 bed 上。
fling = rushed out 顯示動作急促，flung 很貼切。

exercises.original: He threw the door open and ran outside.
exercises.zh: 他猛地把門推開，跑到外面。

options.explanation: fling = fling the door open 是常見固定結構，表示猛地打開。
tossed = 不能自然修飾 door open。
hurled = 不通常說 hurl a door open。

exercises.original: She threw the papers across the desk in frustration.
exercises.zh: 她沮喪地把文件甩過桌面。

options.explanation: fling = in frustration + papers 顯示快速帶情緒的動作，flung 最自然。
slid = 會變成沿桌面滑動，不是甩出。

words.note: 常用於棒球和其他運動，表示有控制地把球投給另一人或目標；也可泛指向前用力投擲。
words.example: The pitcher pitched the ball toward home plate.

exercises.original: The player threw the ball toward the batter.
exercises.zh: 球員把球投向擊球手。

options.explanation: pitch = 棒球中把球投向 batter，標準動詞是 pitch。
tossed = 對正式棒球投球過於輕。
hurled = 有力量但不具棒球技術意味。

exercises.original: He threw three fast balls during practice.
exercises.zh: 他練習時投了三球快速球。

options.explanation: tossed = 不能表達正式投球動作。
pitch = 在球類訓練中有控制地投球，pitched 很自然。

exercises.original: The coach showed the child how to throw the ball properly.
exercises.zh: 教練示範給孩子看如何正確投球。

options.explanation: toss = 可能太輕，且若是正式投球技術則不夠精確。
pitch = 若上下文是投手技術教學，pitch 比 general throw 更精確。

words.note: 表示以較高弧線把球或物體拋出去，通常力量中等；常見於網球、足球和日常投擲。
words.example: He lobbed the ball over the defender.
words.exampleZh: 他把球高拋過防守球員。

exercises.original: She threw the ball high over the defender.
exercises.zh: 她把球高拋過防守球員。

options.explanation: hurled = 通常更直接、快速，不強調弧線。
lob = high over the defender 明確是高弧線 lob。
pitched = 不是投手對擊球手。
tossed = 力度和弧線控制可能不足。

exercises.original: He threw the tennis ball gently over the net.
exercises.zh: 他輕輕把網球高拋過網。

options.explanation: lob = 網球中高弧線越網，lobbed 最精確。

exercises.original: The goalkeeper threw the ball over the approaching player.
exercises.zh: 守門員把球高拋過迎面而來的球員。

options.explanation: hurled = 會更像大力直線投擲。
lob = 足球中把球高拋越過對手可自然用 lob。

words.note: 很口語，表示隨意或用力把某物扔出去；語氣比 throw 更隨便。
words.example: Just chuck the empty bottle in the recycling bin.
words.exampleZh: 把空瓶扔進回收箱就可以。

exercises.original: Just throw the empty box in the recycling bin.
exercises.zh: 把空盒扔進回收箱就可以。

options.explanation: chuck = 非正式、隨手扔進垃圾或回收箱，chuck 很自然。
drop = 可以，但未必表示向 bin 裡扔。

exercises.original: He threw his backpack into the back seat.
exercises.zh: 他把背囊隨手扔到後座。

options.explanation: heave = 除非背囊很重，否則過強。
chuck = 日常隨手把物件扔到某處，chucked 很口語自然。
drop = 只是往下放，不如 chuck 有拋擲感。

exercises.original: She threw the old magazines away.
exercises.zh: 她把舊雜誌扔掉了。

options.explanation: place = 與 away 的棄置語義不符。
chuck = chuck away 是很口語的『扔掉』。

words.note: 表示因物件很重或需要大力而用力拋、推或搬動；比 hurl 更突出重量和費力。
words.example: They heaved the heavy bag into the truck.
words.exampleZh: 他們使勁把重袋扔進貨車。

exercises.original: They threw the heavy sack onto the truck.
exercises.zh: 他們使勁把沉重麻袋扔上貨車。

options.explanation: tossed = 對 heavy sack 太輕鬆。
lobbed = 不強調重量和費力。
heave = heavy sack 明確需要用力，heaved 最精確。

exercises.original: He threw the suitcase onto the luggage rack with effort.
exercises.zh: 他費力把行李箱扔上行李架。

options.explanation: tossed = 和 with effort 不符。
heave = with effort + suitcase 很適合 heave。

exercises.original: The workers threw the timber aside one piece at a time.
exercises.zh: 工人逐件使勁把木材扔到一旁。

options.explanation: chucked = 較口語且不如 heave 強調費力。
heave = 對沉重 timber 作費力搬動／拋移，heaved 很自然。

words.note: 當 throw 強調把某物高速送出去、使其進入空中或朝某方向飛行時可用；也常見於 projectile、ball、rocket 等。
words.example: He launched the ball deep into the field.
words.exampleZh: 他把球大力投向球場深處。

exercises.original: He threw the ball deep into the field.
exercises.zh: 他把球大力投向球場深處。

options.explanation: launch = deep into the field 暗示強力送出，launched 很自然。

exercises.original: The child threw the toy rocket into the air.
exercises.zh: 孩子把玩具火箭投向空中。

options.explanation: tossed = 可用但缺少 rocket 的『發射』語感。
launch = rocket 類物體向空中送出，launch 比 general throw 更具體。

exercises.original: She threw the frisbee across the field with a powerful motion.
exercises.zh: 她大力把飛碟投過球場。

options.explanation: launch = powerful motion + long distance 支持 launched。

words.note: 在運動或描述動作結果時，可用來表示把球或物體送向某方向；比 throw 更著重結果和方向。
words.example: She sent the ball across the court with one quick throw.

exercises.original: He threw the ball across the court to his teammate.
exercises.zh: 他把球投過球場給隊友。

options.explanation: cast = 不合一般球場語境。
send = 如果重點是把球送到另一端／另一人，sent 可自然表達結果。

exercises.original: She threw the pass down the wing.
exercises.zh: 她把球傳向邊路。

options.explanation: send = 運動中描述把球送向某區域，send 很自然。
tossed = 可能過輕，且不強調結果。

exercises.original: One strong throw sent the ball into the crowd.
exercises.zh: 一次強力投擲把球送進觀眾席。

options.explanation: send = 這裡 sent 突出投擲造成的方向結果，而不是投擲方式本身。
pitched = 若非棒球語境不適合。

words.note: 表示帶擺動動作地扔出去，也可指把某物隨手甩到肩上或某處；比 toss 更有 swinging motion。
words.example: He slung the backpack over his shoulder.

exercises.original: He threw the bag over his shoulder and left.
exercises.zh: 他把袋子甩到肩上便離開了。

options.explanation: sling = sling a bag over your shoulder 是非常自然的固定搭配。
tossed = 可以，但 over his shoulder 更自然是 sling。

exercises.original: She threw the camera strap around her neck.
exercises.zh: 她把相機帶甩到頸上。

options.explanation: sling = 帶狀物件以擺動方式掛上身體，slung 很自然。

exercises.original: He threw the jacket over the back of the chair.
exercises.zh: 他把外套甩到椅背上。

options.explanation: sling = over the back of the chair + 衣物很適合 sling 的甩掛動作。
dropped = 不一定是 over the back。

falseSynonyms.zh: 掉下／放下不等於扔 drop 表示讓物件向下落，通常沒有向前投擲動作；throw 則有主動拋出的力量。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You drop something downward; you throw it outward.

falseSynonyms.zh: 放置不等於投擲 place 表示小心把東西放到某處；throw 通常較快速、有拋擲動作。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Placing is controlled and gentle; throwing involves a projecting motion.

falseSynonyms.zh: 推不等於扔 push 是施力令物件沿表面或方向移動；throw 通常令物件離手並飛行。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A pushed object may stay in contact; a thrown object leaves the hand.

falseSynonyms.zh: 踢不等於扔 kick 用腳施力；throw 通常用手或手臂。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You kick with your foot and throw with your hand.

falseSynonyms.zh: toss 通常比 throw 更輕 toss 多表示輕鬆、較短距離地拋；throw 可以很輕也可以很用力。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A toss is usually lighter and more casual than a throw.

falseSynonyms.zh: hurl 通常比 throw 更猛烈 hurl 強調大力、快速，甚至帶憤怒；不能在所有普通 throw 語境中互換。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Hurl is a much stronger action than an ordinary throw.

falseSynonyms.zh: 投擲與丟棄不同 throw 是投擲；throw away 常表示丟掉、棄置。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Throw the ball. Throw away the rubbish.

falseSynonyms.zh: 原形與過去分詞不同 throw 是原形；thrown 是過去分詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She can throw far. The ball was thrown across the field.
